required_prompts.text: What did we discover that was not explicit before, and what exact evidence made it visible?
What could disprove the finding, and what conflicting or missing evidence have we considered?
Which declared dependencies, actors, decisions or sources connect apparently separate candidate routes?
Which verification question or review could most change our available options?
Are we still working towards the client’s explicit target and success criteria?
What may be stale, what could follow from our actions, and what event should make us reconsider?
Which findings belong in 8BALL, ENDSTATE, an existing task, or a retained future candidate?
What are we not implementing, why, and where can the owner review or reopen that choice?
What actually passed, what failed, and which claimed capabilities still need independent or native verification?
What might we still have missed, and how can the operator or owner record their own hypothesis?
What course has an authorised human selected, and what exactly would require reconsideration rather than an automatic switch?
Which available inputs were not processed, what limits bound this conclusion, and what could exist outside the current catalogue?
When analysis fails, what safe recovery is available, who contributed the correction, and is the original failure still recorded?
Can the exact implementation and evidence for every delivery claim be recovered, or must that claim remain reported-only?
Does this improve the operator’s next decision or merely increase reviews, alerts and screens? How would we measure the difference?

items.title: Pack content identity is not current case authority
items.observation: A canonical all-section pack digest can detect changes to prompts, policies and adapter declarations, but neither a digest nor a caller subject authenticates a consumer. The read-only consumer needs independently host-authenticated identity, current scoped grants and a fresh revision-bound snapshot; local bearer identity, cross-scope requests and post-read revocation are rejected in focused tests.
items.product_implication: Keep pack review state host-owned and do not use a content pin or preview response as approval, publisher identity or a later commit/send/download ticket.

items.title: Reusable policy templates must not pre-confirm a case
items.observation: The support reuse fixture originally had confirmed policy state. A reusable pack must reject that state, while a live host snapshot may independently record manual policy review. Focused tests show that review alone still cannot satisfy an unobserved authority predicate, and that unrelated catalogue changes fail review matching.
items.product_implication: Keep reusable hypotheses, human policy review, observed authority, action permission, completion and verified remedy outcome separate; never overlay a pack onto live state.

items.title: Passing source consumers do not establish packaged distribution
items.observation: The frozen setuptools manifest lists only endstate. The internal wheel smoke passes but omits endstate.domain_packs; the actual installed-wheel regression run fails test collection with ModuleNotFoundError. Source-isolated reuse and 1415 source tests therefore do not prove this preview ships. No top-level LICENSE/LICENCE file or independent release approval was found/created in this checkpoint.
items.product_implication: Integration must explicitly include the subpackage and rerun installed regressions, then separately settle licence/support/distribution and independent release approval; do not launch SDK/API/MCP from source-only evidence.
